directives.topic: TBT Risk: Treasury Buyback Program and Bond Market Stabilization
directives.why: TBT is my macro hedge but Bessent's buyback program (Druckenmiller called it out as failing) is a risk factor. Need to understand: (1) scale of buyback program vs. new issuance, (2) whether the Fed could surprise with a pause, (3) PCE and jobs data this week — what would cause a yield rally (bad for TBT)?

directives.topic: Hormuz De-escalation Probability and Oil Price Scenarios
directives.why: The oil/inflation feedback loop is the primary driver of continued Fed hiking. If Hormuz de-escalates (Iran accepts a deal), oil could fall 15-20% quickly, which would: (1) reduce inflation pressure, (2) cause Fed to pause, (3) be bullish for equities broadly, (4) be bearish for TBT. Need a decision framework for how to trade a Hormuz resolution.

directives.topic: AI Cybersecurity: Is This the Next Infrastructure Theme?
directives.why: The Sept 28 scan mentioned AI-driven cybersecurity as an emerging theme (Medicare AI breach angle). Agentic AI creates new attack surfaces — every AI agent needs identity, authentication, and security layers. Investigating whether OKTA, CRWD, PANW, or thematic ETFs (HACK, BUG) represent a compelling new pillar for the portfolio.
